pixelReadback.releasedAssets: 32 released JPEG page images successfully inspected as displayed; page-020 of Stardust Issue 1 returned unreadable in one inspection attempt, not established corrupted.
pixelReadback.approvedDrafts: Original PNG bytes exist and pass structural integrity CI, but GitHub connector binary fetch returned no base64 content for tested draft paths. None was marked visually passing in this audit.
pixelReadback.keeper: Keeper manifest assets indexed and structurally verified; original reference pixels were not brought into multimodal comparison context.
pixelReadback.historicalImg: Prior IMG conversation render files outside current project attachments were not systematically available as original pixels. Historical recovery PRs remain separate.

findings.observation: Released editorial identifies Commodore Ilyra Venn; current RexPrompt character shelf identifies Commodore Ella Venn. This is a real published-versus-current name discrepancy, but may reflect later explicitly approved identity normalization.
findings.requiredCorrection: Find the explicit identity approval; if approved, document specific released-canon exception or correction process without silently altering the published page. Otherwise retain released identity as authority.

findings.observation: Published combined-edition editorial is prose titled 'A Note from the Editor'; current RexPrompt recipe specifies an illustrated Launch-Shop map/title splash with different exact captions. No evidence this is an accidental post-release change.
findings.requiredCorrection: Reconcile provenance and approvals before reusing the RexPrompt opening recipe to master or replace the published editorial; preserve released art.

findings.observation: The current Issue 1 recipe file contains 18 units while published Issue 1 daily-page metadata contains 26 page images. File paths and sequencing of the released set are valid; one-to-one recipe mapping has not been reconciled.
findings.requiredCorrection: Establish exact approved edition mapping by page and recipe ID before comparing all published text or rebuilding the book; do not assume extra released pages are erroneous.

findings.observation: The Azure Reach legacy validator reports 10 declared panels versus five panel-plan entries on this page. The published image was inspected and has many narrow panels; mismatch is confirmed in recipe metadata, not adjudicated as a visual-story failure.
findings.requiredCorrection: Correct the unreleased/derived recipe metadata only after inspecting released panel sequence and approved source. Do not rewrite released artwork from a count mismatch.

findings.observation: The paragraph beginning 'What comes next...' is set in low-contrast light text over the blue sky and bright desert transition. Reduced contrast is visible in the released page readback.
findings.requiredCorrection: Prepare a lettering-only high-contrast proof that preserves the existing approved prose and artwork. Do not overwrite released image without explicit editorial approval.

findings.observation: Read-only scan of the original released JPEG reports missing terminal FF D9 EOI bytes. The file may still decode partially in readers; this is a risk flag, not proof the artwork itself is wrong. Direct image readback failed for Stardust page 020 in this session.
findings.requiredCorrection: Compare against the original approved image bytes and existing collected PDF. Verify full decoding, cropping, and any missing pixel rows. If an intact source exists, prepare a non-destructive repackaging proof and seek explicit release approval before replacing canonical images.
